newsitem.title: UK: BFI unchanged again, rate trends vary as to area.
newsitem.headline: BFI unchanged again, rate trends vary as to area.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Indexs (BFI) was again unchanged at 1,281 points on Thursday and the Baltic Handy index was up one at 1,080.

The main features of the dry cargo market were sharply higher rates paid for Capers for transatlantic business although charterers were insisting on confidentiality clauses which restricted information reaching the market.
Japanese charterers were active for Panamax tonnage for short periods in the Far East and rates continued to improve in that area, brokers said.
In the North Atlantic there was no improvement in rate levels for Panamaxes or Handy-sizes and demand for the latter type in the South Atlantic was said to be weakening.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 20 to 10 points lower and turnover totalled 85 lots.
